details.question: Which company has the lowest market share in the fiscal year 2024-2025
details.expected_sql: WITH company_sales AS (SELECT comname, SUM(netweight_tmt) AS company_total FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND fiscal_year = '2024-2025' GROUP BY comname), total_market AS (SELECT SUM(netweight_tmt) AS market_total FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND fiscal_year = '2024-2025') SELECT company_sales.comname, ROUND((company_sales.company_total * 100.0) / NULLIF(total_market.market_total, 0), 2) AS market_share_percentage FROM company_sales CROSS JOIN total_market ORDER BY market_share_percentage ASC LIMIT 1;

details.question: Compare Lubes sales in South Zone for FY 2024-2025 against FY 2023-2024 and calculate growth percentage.
details.expected_sql: WITH sales_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = '2023-2024' THEN netweight_tmt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS previous_sales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = '2024-2025' THEN netweight_tmt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_sales FROM industry_performance WHERE (category != 'O' OR category IS NULL) AND sbu_name = 'LUBES' AND zone_name = 'SZ' AND fiscal_year IN ('2023-2024', '2024-2025')) SELECT ROUND(previous_sales::numeric, 2) AS previous_sales_tmt, ROUND(current_sales::numeric, 2) AS current_sales_tmt, ROUND((current_sales - previous_sales)::numeric, 2) AS sales_difference_tmt, ROUND(CASE WHEN previous_sales = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((current_sales - previous_sales) * 100.0 / previous_sales)::numeric END, 2) AS sales_growth_percentage FROM sales_totals;
